Your prompt bubble is now tinted with the theme's accent color, so it no longer blends into the gray rows around it.

- With an Omarchy theme, your prompt bubble used the same gray as slash command rows, code block backgrounds and the chin band, so what you typed was hard to spot when scrolling back. The bubble now mixes the theme's `accent` color into the terminal background (12% on light themes, 22% on dark ones). Its shape, side and text color are unchanged
- A theme with no `accent` in `colors.toml` keeps the gray bubble. So do 256-color terminals (inside tmux), where a mixed tint would land on an unpredictable palette color
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.80.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
